events.title: LIVE: Squash the Swarm, Save Your Sanity
events.summary: The bugs are back — and this time they’re on your desktop. Join \ as we play the Steam demo of \, a scrappy indie pest-control game about squashing, trapping, and outsmarting the swarm one click at a time. We’ll show off the core loop, share a few tips, and hang out in chat.Whether you’re here for the satisfying bug-squashing, the bite-sized chaos, or to ask us anything about making the game — you’re welcome. Wishlist it on Steam, try the demo, and tell us which bug deserves to be squashed first

events.title: 【Next Fest Coming Soon】Demo is playable! & GIVEAWAY
events.summary: Hi everyone! Desktop Insecticide is part of the October Steam Next Fest, and the free Demo is ready to download!This is an incremental shooter where your computer desktop becomes the battlefield. Swarms of mechanical bugs pour in from all edges of the screen, trying to destroy your PC. Grab a variety of weapons to fight back against the bug horde. events.title: From 0 to 24!!! Your feedback is all that truly matters.
events.summary: A week ago, my casual FPS incremental game officially launched its Steam Playtest. Back then, one stat from the backend absolutely crushed my spirits: the median playtime was zero minutes!!!It was honestly heartbreaking. It wasn’t that no one tried the game. Most players would boot up the demo, play for just a few seconds, and quit right away.
